white_reference: the coaming's white gelcoat in the same photo: rope crowns compared with it in CIE L*; gelcoat albedo taken as sRGB ~210 (L* 84), per the plan's PBR limits

pick_over_diameter.note: braid crossing pitch along the line on the visible face, 21 px against a 48-55 px diameter (FFT of the luminance along the straight run of the coil). Game: 5 d lay / 12 = 0.42 d. Within 10%: pass

fleck_repeat_over_diameter.note: red fleck groups along the line, 63 px; game ~1.25 d

L2_white_crown.note: rope crown p90 L* 71.3 vs gelcoat p90 69.7 in the same light: the rope's bright fibres are about as light as the gelcoat (L* ~86 after WB) and ~5.6 b* warmer (ivory-beige)

L2_red.note: red tracer still a strong red (hue ~23 deg, chroma high); reviewers in rounds 1-3 all said it must stay saturated: dyes barely fade on a club boat

target_status.L3: estimated: a kept boat replaces her lines every ~3 years
target_status.L4: estimated from the plan's description; needs a photo

rounds.ladder: L0, L3, L1 near-identical; L2 and L4 clear (all three reviewers)
